solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Moving around on and off, nine a bed, sadly due, we hear, to be homeless

indicators.note: things moving around are shifted into new places, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: IX is nine in Roman numerals

indicators.note: something done sadly is done badly, so these letters are reworked
says the word for due is to be heard spoken, not read

parts.note: money due is money owed

explanation.surface: A sad tale of someone drifting about, sleeping in a shared bed, on the brink of losing their home.
explanation.walkthrough: Two anagram signals work on separate stretches: 'Moving around' on the first group, 'sadly' on 'a bed'. 'we hear' turns the word for due (money owed) into a sound-alike. 'to be' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone with no settled address is homeless; the phrase is the standard police and court description.

clue.text: Machine offering some risk exciting to braindead men

indicators.note: exciting stirs things up, so the letters that follow are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: Something risky that thrills thoughtless young men.
explanation.definitionFit: A fruit machine in a pub or arcade is a gamble, and its nickname comes from its single lever.

clue.text: Treatment of our veins neglecting one of psychiatric symptoms

definitions.note: an adjectival phrase, matching the adjective

indicators.note: treatment works material over, so the remaining letters are processed into a new order
neglecting leaves something out, here a letter from the fodder

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A doctor treating varicose veins overlooks one of the patient's mental symptoms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'neglecting one' drops I from OUR VEINS, leaving OURVENS for 'Treatment of' to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: Nervous disorders and nervous breakdowns are older terms for psychiatric conditions, so the adjective describes such symptoms.

clue.text: Layer-on of hands hath a relief brought about

indicators.note: to bring a ship about is to turn it round, so these letters are turned into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone who lays on hands has brought relief, in Biblical language.
explanation.definitionFit: A practitioner claiming to cure by touch is known for the laying on of hands, so the clue coins 'layer-on' for that person.

clue.text: Ruler overthrowing Congress and King

indicators.note: overthrowing turns something upside down, so in a down entry the letters are read backwards

parts.note: sexual congress is intercourse, sex
REX is Latin for king

explanation.surface: A ruler topples the legislature and the monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Congress' is not the US legislature but sexual congress.
explanation.definitionFit: The Persian emperor who invaded Greece was a ruler of the Achaemenid empire.

clue.text: Past name engraved in clock face across the square

indicators.note: something engraved in a surface sits within it, so these letters go inside

parts.note: the face of a clock is its dial
ago means in the past

explanation.surface: An old name has been engraved on the clock face in the town square.
explanation.definitionFit: A line running corner to corner cuts across a square slantwise.

clue.text: Cricketer, wretched youngster, missing out on runs

indicators.note: missing out on something means going without it, so a letter is dropped

parts.note: a brat is an unruly child
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A miserable young cricketer fails to score.
explanation.definitionFit: A batsman, someone who bats, is a cricketer; the short form is common in commentary.

clue.text: Understand answer before inserting noun, fool

indicators.note: inserting a letter puts it inside the word for understand

parts.note: to dig is slang for to understand
the answer to the previous clue, 6 Down, is BAT

explanation.surface: An instruction to grasp an answer before slipping in a noun, ending in an insult.
explanation.walkthrough: 'answer before' means the solution to the clue before this one, 6 Down.
explanation.definitionFit: A dingbat is slang for an eccentric or stupid person, a synonym for a fool.

clue.text: Make up for the grocery scales?

definitions.meaning: to offset or compensate for something
read as two words, the scales sitting on a shop's counter

explanation.surface: A shopkeeper's scales compensate for a shortfall.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading splits the word into COUNTER and BALANCE, a weighing balance on a shop counter.
explanation.definitionFit: To offset is to cancel out one force with another, and a shop's weighing scales stand on the counter.

clue.text: Attention given to story initially reported on a previous date

parts.note: to give an ear is to pay attention
a story is a lie, a fib

indicators.note: initially picks the opening letter of the word that follows

explanation.surface: Someone listens to a story first reported on an earlier day.
explanation.definitionFit: Earlier means at a previous time, before now.

clue.text: Soldier with head cut threatened merchant in drama

parts.note: a soldier ant is a worker type of ant

indicators.note: cut docks the tail, removing a final letter

parts.note: onion is slang for the head

explanation.surface: A beheaded soldier threatening a trader in a play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'head' is not the start of a word: it is the slang ONION, cut to ONIO.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's Merchant of Venice is the man threatened by Shylock with forfeiting a pound of flesh.

clue.text: Victorian bounder's capacity to dodge getting married

definitions.note: the 's stands for 'is', linking to the wordplay

indicators.note: to dodge is to avoid, so this letter is avoided in the word

parts.note: room is space or capacity

explanation.surface: A Victorian cad's ability to avoid getting married.
explanation.walkthrough: Victoria here is the Australian state, not the era, and the bounder is a kangaroo, not a cad.
explanation.definitionFit: A kangaroo, bounding across Victoria in Australia, is known familiarly by this short form.

clue.text: Stuff of transfusion: A&E doctor encountering clot in hospital at first

indicators.note: at first puts this letter before everything else in the charade

parts.note: accident and emergency, the hospital casualty department, written AE
MO is a medical officer
a glob is a clot or lump

explanation.surface: A medical scene: A&E staff dealing with blood clots during a transfusion.
explanation.definitionFit: Blood transfusions supply red cells rich in the oxygen-carrying protein, the very stuff transfused.

clue.text: Location of washers below vents evenly put in recently

indicators.note: put in places these letters inside the word for recently

parts.note: late means recently, as in 'of late'
under means below

indicators.note: evenly picks the even-numbered letters of the word

explanation.surface: Plumbing washers fitted under some vents not long ago.
explanation.walkthrough: 'evenly' gives E and T, the second and fourth letters of 'vents'.
explanation.definitionFit: A coin-operated laundry houses rows of washing machines, the 'washers' of the definition.

clue.text: Curate finally overcome, missing first religious festival

indicators.note: finally picks the closing letter of the word
drops the opening letter of the synonym

parts.note: to master is to overcome

explanation.surface: A curate finally beaten, skipping the first service of a church holiday.
explanation.definitionFit: The Christian feast of the Resurrection is the chief religious festival of the church year.

clue.text: Mostly cured, suppressing endless fever, revealing some pain?

indicators.note: suppressing holds something down within, so these letters sit inside
mostly drops the last letter

parts.note: better means recovered, cured

indicators.note: endless drops the final letter

parts.note: ague is a malarial fever

explanation.surface: A patient almost healed, with the fever kept down, still showing some pain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pain' is the French word for bread, which the question mark flags.
explanation.definitionFit: A French stick loaf is one kind of bread, which in French is 'pain', hence 'some pain'.

clue.text: Boss wanting change after power goes around pit

indicators.note: around wraps these letters about the next
with 'goes', after power goes says the letter for power departs
with 'after', says the letter for power leaves the word

parts.note: pence is small change
a mine is a pit, as in a coal pit

explanation.surface: A boss wants things changed once the power at the pit fails.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Boss' is not a manager but a raised knob or swelling.
explanation.definitionFit: A boss is a raised stud or protuberance, and a raised area or bump is likewise an elevation.

clue.text: What'll hold sparrow? Offer tree around river

indicators.note: around puts the first word's letters about the letter for river

parts.note: a bid is an offer
the lime is a tree, the linden

explanation.surface: A sparrow is offered a tree near a river to perch in.
explanation.definitionFit: A sticky substance smeared on twigs was used to trap small birds, holding them fast.

clue.text: Fermented ale and dour roll

indicators.note: fermenting works up a brew, so these letters are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: Brewed beer and a gloomy bread roll.
explanation.definitionFit: A rolled dish of sponge or meat with a filling is a roll in cookery.

clue.text: Gather film of Broads to be distributed

indicators.note: distributed things are spread about, so these letters are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: A film shot on the Norfolk Broads is to be released.
explanation.walkthrough: The Broads are a network of rivers and lakes in Norfolk, England.
explanation.definitionFit: In chemistry, a surface that takes up a thin layer of a substance holds it as a film.

clue.text: Old family abroad, wasting year in Japanese island

parts.note: kin are family

indicators.note: wasting loses something, here a letter

parts.note: away means abroad

explanation.surface: An old family living overseas spends a year doing nothing on a Japanese island.
explanation.definitionFit: The largest of the Ryukyu chain is an island prefecture of southern Japan.

clue.text: Record-player control shifting one end of piece and start of other

indicators.note: shifting moves a letter to another place within the word

parts.note: to steer is to control

indicators.note: picks the letter at one end of the word piece
start of picks the opening letter

explanation.surface: Turning a knob on a hi-fi to switch from one piece to another.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shifting' moves the E (the end of 'piece') in STEER to the end, making STERE.
explanation.definitionFit: A stereo is a sound system that plays records, a two-speaker record-player.

clue.text: Note Saturn misrepresented right here?

definitions.note: a pointer to a place: the body the clue describes

indicators.note: misrepresented means shown wrongly, so these letters are set out in another order

explanation.surface: An astronomer complains that Saturn has been wrongly shown.
explanation.walkthrough: 'here?' points to the very place the clue describes: Saturn misrepresented as a star, rather than the planet it is.
explanation.definitionFit: A collapsed stellar remnant made of densely packed neutrons is a place in the sky, the location 'here' points to.

clue.text: Unwell? Fine to avoid everything one can eat

indicators.note: to avoid something is to leave it out, so this letter is dropped

parts.note: one's fill is as much as one can eat
F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencils

explanation.surface: Feeling poorly? Then skip the all-you-can-eat buffet.
explanation.definitionFit: Ill is a direct synonym for poorly or sick.

clue.text: I had expression of surprise over a Northern US resident

parts.note: contracted, I had is I'd
ah is an exclamation of surprise
O is the cricket abbreviation for over

explanation.surface: Someone recalls once exclaiming in surprise about a northerner.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket an over is a set of six balls, abbreviated O.
explanation.definitionFit: A native or resident of the potato-growing state in the American northwest goes by this demonym.

clue.text: Unconscious, having head swiped in fight

indicators.note: having its head swiped means losing the first letter

parts.note: a bout is a boxing fight

explanation.surface: A boxer knocked senseless after a blow to the head in a fight.
explanation.definitionFit: A boxer knocked senseless is said to be out cold, an idiom for unconscious.

clue.text: Soak with water to prepare for different function

parts.note: to ret is to soak flax or hemp to soften it
rain is water falling from the sky

explanation.surface: Instructions for soaking something in water to ready it for a new use.
explanation.definitionFit: To learn new skills for another job is to be trained afresh, preparing for a different role.

clue.text: Old soccer star facing girlfriend? Perfectly fine till now!

parts.note: George Best was a famous Manchester United footballer of the 1960s
before means in front of, facing
a date is someone one goes out with

explanation.surface: An ageing footballer meets his girlfriend, as fine as he ever was.
explanation.walkthrough: George Best was a Northern Irish footballer for Manchester United in the 1960s.
explanation.definitionFit: Food labels mark the day up to which a product is at its best quality, after which it may decline.
